title: Bowel obstruction and ileus in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the bowel obstruction or ileus (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/15/2026
Reason for Admission: Abdominal distension and slowed bowel movements.

Hospital Course:
Pt is an 83yF admitted with ileus following a recent medication change. Pt presented with significant abdominal bloating and decreased bowel activity. Physical exam showed distended abdomen but no signs of peritonitis. Imaging and clinical evaluation confirmed ileus without mechanical obstruction. Management included NPO status, IV fluids, and conservative supportive care. Pt showed gradual improvement in bowel sounds and gas passage over 72 hours. Resolved with supportive care. Pt tolerated a transition to a clear liquid diet and then a soft diet without complications.

Discharge Diagnoses:
Ileus.

Discharge Medications:
Current meds continued; added stool softener BID PRN.

Follow-up:
F/u with PCP in 1 week for symptom monitoring.

Electronically signed
P. O'Brien, MD
05/15/2026

distractors.why: It is an ileus, not a mechanical obstruction.
